sign_params — DRIVE roadjp op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.sign_params(kind: 'str', *, side: 'float | None' = None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import roadjp; roadjp.sign_params(kind: 'str', *, side: 'float | None' = None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("sign_params"))

Usage

Returns the shape, dimensions and colors of road sign kind (published values; to be checked against the primary source).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

{"shape", "width", "height", "mount_height", "ground", "border", "ink", "side"}。shape は circle / triangle_down / diamond / pentagon / rect。width・height は板の外形 [m]:

円 直径 0.6、逆三角形 一辺 0.6(高さ = 一辺 × √3/2)、菱形 一辺 0.45(対角 = 一辺 × √2)、横長矩形 0.6 × 0.3、五角形(横断歩道)0.6 × 0.6 —— 出典: 道路標識、区画線及び道路標示に関する命令 別表第二 / KICTEC 寸法表。矩形・五角形の寸法は同表で確かめていない(要確認)。side を渡すと一辺(円は直径、菱形は一辺)を置き換える(一時停止 800 mm の記述に合わせるなど)。mount_height = 1.8(路側式、板の下端)。
